cohort: 25 cases of burst abdomen in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, MKCG Medical College Hospital, Berhampur, Odisha from August 2020 to July 2022.
finding: The incidence of burst abdomen was 0.19%, with the majority of cases being emergency caesarean deliveries or gynaecological surgeries, and the most frequent predisposing factors were obstructed labor (in caesarean deliveries), ectopic pregnancy (in gynaecological surgeries), and obesity.
mod_finding: 100% of the caesarean delivery cases that resulted in burst abdomen were emergency cases, and the most frequent indication for these caesarean deliveries was obstructed labor (40%).
followup_time: Average of 6.72 days post-operation (majority occurred between the 6th and 7th post-operative day).  Length of hospital stay averaged 24.52 days.
